video_prompt: One continuous full-frame shot of a dark cozy podcast studio at night: the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — an East Asian woman about 27 years old with light skin and a straight black chin-length bob — sits alone in her armchair and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same headphones, same seat, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the room around her stays still and empty, only the candle flames flicker. She reacts to the person off-camera: curious, surprised, a bit skeptical; during silences in the audio she listens with her mouth closed, nodding slightly.
